Package frc.robot.libraries.Repulsor.Units

Class ShooterUnits

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.libraries.Repulsor.Units.ShooterUnits
public final class ShooterUnits extends Object
Shooter / flywheel unit conversions built on top of WPILib Units.

Conventions: - Distances in meters - Linear velocities in meters per second (m/s) - Angular speeds in rotations per minute (RPM)

Motor -> (gear ratio) -> Flywheel -> (radius) -> Exit velocity

    • motorRpmToExitVelocity

      public static double motorRpmToExitVelocity(double motorRpm, double wheelRadiusMeters, double motorToWheelGearRatio)
      Converts motor RPM to exit velocity (m/s), given a motor-to-flywheel gear ratio.
      Parameters:
      motorRpm - motor speed in RPM
      wheelRadiusMeters - wheel radius in meters
      motorToWheelGearRatio - motor rotations / one wheel rotation (e.g. 3.0 means motor spins 3x per wheel rev)
      Returns:
      exit velocity in m/s
